title: GameShelf gateway API v1 (HTTPS, Bearer tokens, no CORS)
description: All timestamps are Unix seconds (JSON number). IDs are opaque strings. Paths are relative POSIX paths within the mounted share. Fields not known by clients may be ignored. No HTTP token is an SMB password.

backend.description: rpgmz is offered only for the validated MZWebProfile.sakura desktop profile, as index.html before preserved Wine entrances. Unknown NW.js packages are not promoted to WebKit.

coverSHA256.description: Optional identity of administrator default cover; not a personal override.

path.description: Canonical game-relative POSIX path; never .., absolute or .gameshelf-profile

address.description: Explicitly configured HTTPS root URL; no credentials, path, query or fragment.

certificateSHA256.description: Optional leaf certificate DER SHA-256; not an SPKI hash.

address.description: Explicitly configured HTTPS root URL; no credentials, path, query or fragment.

certificateSHA256.description: Optional leaf certificate DER SHA-256; not an SPKI hash.

data.description: JPEG bytes, at most 262144 decoded bytes. Structural marker/dimension validation; 8-bit baseline/extended/progressive, 1 or 3 components, at most 2048×2048.

POST /api/logout.description: Revokes only current HTTP token and leases created with it. Other tokens/devices are unaffected. 503 means closure pending; current token already revoked. Account disable and grant revocation close all affected leases.

body.savePaths: optional [{path:string,kind:file|directory}]; unioned with detected defaults, immutable per edition

GET /api/admin/invitation.description: Credential-free SharedServerInvitation v1. GAMESHELF_PUBLIC_ADDRESS falls back only to configured GAMESHELF_PUBLIC_ORIGIN; never Host/forwarded headers. Optional name comes from GAMESHELF_SERVER_NAME; optional pin from GAMESHELF_CERTIFICATE_SHA256. Missing/invalid invitation configuration returns 503. No tokens, passwords, account IDs, serverID, SMB credentials or source paths.

response.name: string
response.setupRequired: bool, true only when users table is empty (including no disabled users)

GET /api/server-info.description: Public display identity only; does not enumerate games or accounts.

POST /api/setup.description: First administrator only. Serialized SQLite transaction checks empty users and setup digest, creates administrator and login token, consumes capability. Invalid capability 403; initialized service 409. Invalid input rolls back. Ordinary invitation cannot initialize. Shares login rate limit. Body at most 16 KiB.

POST /api/admin/users/{id}/rename.description: Only authenticated administrator self-rename. Preserves account ID, password, uid, roles, grants, tokens, leases and metadata. Other account target 403; duplicate username 409.

GET /api/personal-library.description: Authenticated account only, including administrators. No user selector. Empty account returns libraries:[]. At most 8 libraries/account and at most 4 MiB of actual UTF-8 HTTP response JSON (including escaping, spaces and full snapshot envelopes). Query reads at most 9 small device descriptors before loading any bounded snapshot. Legacy overquota data returns 413 without truncation or deletion; individual reads remain available.

GET /api/personal-library/{deviceUUID}.description: Missing device returns 404 without creating a row. First POST uses expectedRevision:0. UUID input accepts uppercase or lowercase canonical hyphenated strings; all device, game and collection UUIDs in successful responses are normalized lowercase hyphenated. Envelope is exactly deviceID/revision/snapshot; account namespace comes from the authenticated token, with no arbitrary account selector.

POST /api/personal-library/{deviceUUID}.description: Atomic account/device-scoped CAS, revision increments once. Stale revision 409 without mutation. Snapshot compact UTF-8 JSON at most 512 KiB; HTTP body at most 512 KiB + 1024 bytes. Rejects extra fields at every level, duplicate game/collection UUIDs, undefined or repeated collection references, nonfinite/negative times and duplicate JSON keys. No paths, executable resources or saves. Maximum 1000 games/200 collections; titles ≤1024 UTF-8 bytes, collection names ≤240 UTF-8 bytes; playtimeSeconds in 0..31557600000. Snapshot UUIDs are normalized without changing identity. Account limit: 8 device libraries and 4 MiB for the complete full-snapshot list using the exact HTTP JSON encoder. Creation/update violating either returns 413 and rolls back. A successful CAS also atomically deletes personal cover blobs whose games are absent from the new snapshot.

POST /api/personal-library/{deviceUUID}/.description: Atomic SQLite blob replacement; validation failure leaves previous image intact. HTTP body at most 350552 bytes. Unknown fields rejected. Requires an existing device library and game in that account’s snapshot; unknown device/game 404. Cover rows are bounded by 8 libraries × 1000 game UUIDs (each ≤256 KiB); repeated uploads replace the existing row. Removed games are pruned in the same metadata CAS transaction. Legacy accounts with more than 8 device libraries cannot add/replace cover blobs (413); individual reads remain available.

title.description: Surrounding whitespace is trimmed. The resulting title must be nonempty and at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Unicode control/format/surrogate characters are rejected even before trimming.

POST /api/admin/games/{gameID}/metadata.description: Administrator-only display-title update for an existing published 32-hex game ID. Unknown game returns 404; invalid or extra fields 400; nonadministrator 403; unauthenticated 401. Changes only games.title, never grants, entries, source paths, saves, covers or game identity. Does not publish a candidate or grant access. Republication of an unchanged edition retains the canonical published title while refreshing recognized entrances. Default 16 KiB HTTP request-body bound applies.

POST /api/admin/games/{gameID}/cover.description: Atomic SQLite blob replacement; validation failure leaves previous image intact. HTTP body at most 350552 bytes. Unknown fields rejected.

GET /api/personal-library/{deviceUUID}/c.description: Private to authenticated account/device/game, including against other administrators. Missing 404. Independent of snapshot revision; no user selector. Never overwrites a canonical cover. Requires the device library and game UUID in that authenticated account’s current snapshot; unknown device/game returns 404. Other accounts cannot insert or access covers through matching UUIDs.

GET /api/games/{gameID}/cover.description: Requires current explicit grant, including administrators. No grant 403; granted missing cover 404. Only published gateway game IDs (existing 32-hex format).

statusCodes.401: missing, expired or revoked token/invalid login
statusCodes.403: admin required or no game grant
statusCodes.404: not found or another account's lease
statusCodes.409: CAS revision conflict, initialized service, duplicate username/root, active writer, changed edition or expired heartbeat
statusCodes.413: Default body >16 KiB; dedicated personal snapshot ≤512 KiB (+1024-byte envelope); cover ≤256 KiB decoded (+base64 envelope). Other routes keep 16 KiB. Account metadata quota: max 8 libraries and full actual JSON list max 4 MiB; quota failures roll back writes.
statusCodes.503: unavailable source/mount/export/shutdown pending; never retry a launch without successful lease

profile.windowsUsers: .gameshelf-profile/WindowsUsers/Player is the stable shared-account profile across Mac login names. Public and Default use separate real directories. Client-local user links point here; no SMB symlinks required.
profile.registry: client account-private; not synchronized by gateway

lease.credentials: fresh gateway-only SMB user/password for every lease; never persisted in HTTP lease database; no NAS credentials
lease.reassignment: disable/remove SMB credential, remove share, reload, close-share, unmount WITHOUT lazy/force, then mark closed; failure keeps writer locked

seedSavePrivacy.notDetected: Arbitrary engine-specific save names require explicit administrator configuration. Generic .dat/.json/.rvdata2 assets remain readable.
seedSavePrivacy.initialization: First private overlay hides source seed saves using whiteouts/opaque empty dirs; root-private manifest prevents clearing private saves on reopen. Missing/mismatched manifests on existing uppers refuse export.
seedSavePrivacy.links: Internal symlinks strictly resolved; absolute lower links rewritten in private overlay only; wide links disabled. Source root/ancestors and external/broken/cyclic/special-target links rejected.

sharedWebKit.profile: MZWebProfile.sakura (same five exact SHA-256 fingerprints as Sources/Core.swift)
sharedWebKit.requirements: RPG Maker MZ metadata, a valid MZ-header Game.exe, regular index.html and all five exact profile hashes. No symlink traversal in root, ancestors or profile files.

readBudget.indexHTML: regular-file check only; no content hash

sharedWebKit.fallback: Keep all previously eligible Wine/language entrances and platform editions; mismatch, missing, linked, special or oversized metadata never opts into WebKit. Unknown shared web/native engines remain unsupported without a separate supported adapter.
sharedWebKit.publication: Scanning does not change published games. Explicit re-publication may refresh entrances of an unchanged edition while preserving its game ID, grants and private state.
sharedWebKit.saveSupport: Requires the client shared WebKit account/game-private save adapter; this server change recognizes and advertises only the validated profile.

setup.permissions: 0600, gateway-owned regular single-link file. Empty service and configured GAMESHELF_PUBLIC_ADDRESS (or PUBLIC_ORIGIN) only; name and pin use existing invitation configuration. Never derives Host. Random setup token only in this private file; only SHA-256 digest in database. Stable over restart when configuration matches; configuration changes regenerate capability. Removed/invalidated after first account; ordinary invitation route never contains capability. Not served over HTTP. Deliver privately, never publish/commit/log. Removing public address configuration invalidates any previous capability.
